thread:
ajay: Deploybot alerted: elevated error rate for llm-embed-v2 on runtime 3.14 in eu-west, warmups failing. Proposing we quarantine that model group and soft-unpin runtime 3.14 for the cohort during tonight's change window (23:00 UTC). Any objections?

sophie: link to the telemetry? and current error rate numbers pls

ajay: https://telemetry.internal/alerts/17665 - error spike ~3.8% failed ops over 10m, p99 generation latency jumped to 2.7s for that model group. logs show kernel mismatch on quant decode path.

deploybot: automated: detected deploy anomaly for runtime=3.14, model_group=llm-embed-v2. Created quarantine ticket #Q-4982.

nina: is this definitely runtime and not SDK? last SDK patch touched attention kernel shims yesterday

ajay: good call. I ran a quick canary with the previous SDK (sdk-2.13) locally — still fails. The failing stack traces reference the C++ quant kernels introduced in runtime 3.14. SDK looks unlikely.

kevin: whats the exact action? soft-unpin means routing to runtime 3.13 for that model group only, right? will dedicated customers be affected?

ajay: yes, soft-unpin = route llm-embed-v2 -> runtime 3.13 in eu-west only. No global rollback. Dedicated customers on pinned fleets remain unchanged unless they opt-in.

sophie: can we get a deploybot command snippet to run? want to paste into runbook for night shift

ajay: put this in the runbook:
```
# quarantine and route back to 3.13 for llm-embed-v2
deploybot quarantine --model-group llm-embed-v2 --reason "kvcache-quant-regression-3.14"
deploybot set-routing --model-group llm-embed-v2 --target-runtime 3.13 --region eu-west --mode soft
```

kevin: rollback/abort triggers? we should be explicit so night shift can escalate correctly

ajay: propose triggers: ">=2% increase in failed_ops over 5m or sustained p99 > 2s for 10m" -> automatic rollback to prior routing and page oncall. Manual escalation if error rate >5% or customer SLA breaches.

oncall: acknowledged. I'll be on standby 22:45-00:30 UTC. If deploybot flips routing, please add me to the incident channel.

sophie: we need a short release note/externally-facing blurb in case customers notice increased fallbacks. Draft suggestion:
```
Release note (short): We observed a runtime compatibility regression affecting some quantized embedding models in eu-west. We have temporarily routed affected models to the previous runtime to maintain stability while we patch the runtime. No action required from customers.
```

ajay: +1. I'll add a line to the status page if we keep this longer than 1h.

deploybot: scheduled-action: soft-unpin route will execute at 1766562000 (2026-03-23T23:00:00Z) unless cancelled. Ticket Q-4982 updated with runbook.

nina: can we attach the specific failing backtrace to the ticket? helps runtime team triage.
ajay: done, attached gist: https://gist.internal/qa/stack-embed-17665.txt

kevin: ok from infra side. leaving a note: ensure canary traffic is 10% for first 10m then 50% for next 10m if stable, else full traffic redirect.

sophie: agreed. also add a short QA checklist: smoke 5 queries with long and short prompts, verify KV cache hit, verify embeddings checksum match previous runtime.

ajay: will add checklist to Q-4982. plan: execute soft-unpin at 23:00, monitor 30m, if stable we leave routing until runtime 3.14 patch lands. If regressions persist, escalate to rollback+postmortem.

oncall: I'll create the incident channel when the action runs: #inc-q-4982. ping me when scheduled.

ajay: thanks all. tagging @deploybot to confirm scheduled window and runbook presence. :thumbsup:

deploybot: confirmed: runbook present, schedule locked, watchers set: [ajay, sophie, oncall, kevin].
